review_process_blockers.title: Required independent-first ordering was not maintained; mandatory reading is incomplete
review_process_blockers.cause: The reviewer read ACT integration-stage-1/README.md containing writer validation/handoff claims before saving its independent-first-judgment and receipt. It subsequently could not certify the required fresh independent-first sequence. Complete mandatory reading of both diff streams and all qualified controls/audit payload meanings was not achieved.
review_process_blockers.minimal_legal_input: The exact externally frozen ACT and FULL role package supplied for this read-only independent review; no behavior fixture or runtime input is required for this procedural blocker.
ordered_result: Both unfiltered diff streams captured and inventoried
Integration README read for navigation, exposing writer validation/handoff claims
Independent first judgment and immutable receipt saved afterward
No FULL quality PASS or acceptance issued; complete mandatory reading still outstanding
review_process_blockers.reverse_contrast: A fresh reviewer consumes complete unfiltered differences and required qualified/source/formal contracts, freezes its own first judgment and receipt, and only then reads/compares author checks. Completing that sequence is necessary, not by itself a quality PASS.
review_process_blockers.acceptance: Obtain a fresh complete independent FULL exact-ACT gate using the prescribed ordering. The same ACT may be reviewed if unchanged. This limitation does not request changes to correct formal behavior, a new canonical finding or recursive payload hashes. All seven affected exact gates remain independently mandatory.
review_process_blockers.evidence_limits: Self-observed reviewer procedure plus exact document/hash inventories; no proven ACT semantic defect. No source execution, runtime, Demo, media, asset, capacity, plugin or backend validation.
